text:
108  THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE

[Photograph: Program cover for San Jacinto Day celebration. Image shows a floral/botanical illustration at top. Text reads:]

Palmam qui meruit ferat.

SAN JACINTO DAY.

—ANNIVERSARY OF—

Sam Houston and Union Literary Societies

OF GRAYSON COLLEGE.

Wednesday Even, Friday Evening, April 21st, 1891.

* * *

Your presence is respectfully requested.
notes: Printed page 108. This page is a photograph/scan of a printed program cover for the San Jacinto Day anniversary of the Sam Houston and Union Literary Societies of Grayson College. The Latin motto 'Palmam qui meruit ferat' means 'Let him who has earned it bear the palm.' Some text at bottom may be partially illegible.
